sections.title: The generations from Adam to Noah

blocks.text: Genesis 5 records a genealogy from Adam through Seth, Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah, then names Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Its repeated pattern of begetting, years, sons and daughters, and death is interrupted by Enoch’s walking with God and by Lamech’s hope connected with Noah.

The chapter opens by recalling that humanity was made in God’s likeness and that Adam’s son was in Adam’s own likeness and image. The genealogy thus links family succession with remembered identity, while the supplied BHF evidence describes genealogies as a way of preserving belonging, rights, and memory.
